prompt: Ella: a slender adult woman, always airborne, in a tall bent pointed witch hat with a wide brim. Long straight dark brown hair falls to mid-back, never short. A dark cloth mask hides her whole face; two small gold eye glints are its only light. A separate long ragged scarf with two tails. Worn layered dark dress with belt, long sleeves, jagged knee-length skirt, stockings, laced boots, gloves; no skin shows. One umbrella, no wand: a shallow dome almost as wide as she is tall, eight broad gores alternating black and taupe, scalloped hem; a long thin dark shaft; a narrow pierced diamond clock-hand terminal at the free end. At the canopy's peak a short dark stem rises from a small collar and ends in one small round bead with a tiny point, barely wider than the shaft. Both gloved hands hold the one shaft. Images: 1 gives her hat, mask and hair; 2, her open umbrella. Level side view facing right, she falls slowly, torso upright, boots hanging; the umbrella lies level at her hip, finial behind, diamond pointing right. Three figures in a row, same scale, 65% of canvas height, only green between them. Left: canopy furled. Middle: canopy snapped open behind her; a small gold pulse flies right, clear of her. Right: canopy half closed, air ahead empty. Style: dark etched storybook engraving for a 2D game sprite: brown-black ink, sepia wash, fine cross-hatching. Near-black silhouette (ink #171614, umber #3A2C25), dark-on-dark interior detail, ragged cloth edges. Thin rim light and a 3 px outline, both warm candle-cream: spark-white #FFF3D6 with touches of gold #E9C46A, always more red than green, never lemon. No glow. Background: one flat pure green #00FF00, edge to edge, unbroken, empty. Nothing on the figure is green. No text.
